Rashi on Keritot 15a:11:1.english: One name - [The prohibition of] "to a menstruant you shall not approach."

Rashi on Keritot 15a:11:2.hebrew: שהיא אחות אביו - כדמפרש לקמי', ברשיעא בר רשיעא:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:11:2.english: Who is the sister of his father - As [the Gemara] explains further on, [this occurs] through a wicked person, son of a wicked person.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:13:1.hebrew: ערות אחותו גלה - מפרש בפ"ק (לעיל כריתות ב:) דאייתר ליה להא דרשא:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:13:1.english: He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness - [The Gemara] explains in the first chapter (above, Keritot 2b) that [this phrase] is superfluous for this exposition.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:15:1.hebrew: בא עליה - על אחת מכל העריות, וחזר ובא עליה בהעלם אחת:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:15:1.english: Engages in intercourse with her - with one of any of the forbidden relatives, and then again engages in intercourse with her in one lapse of awareness.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:16:1.hebrew: בבא על ה' נשים נדות - בהעלם אחת:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:16:1.english: With one who engages in intercourse with five menstruating women - In one lapse of awareness.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:16:2.hebrew: הואיל והוא גרם להן - להביא כל אחת חטאת, דהיינו ה' חטאות, הלכך הוא נמי מייתי ה' חטאות. אבל ה' ביאות בערוה אחת בהעלם א', היא נמי לא מתיא אלא חד, וכן הוא:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:16:2.english: Since he caused them - to each bring a sin-offering, which is five sin-offerings; therefore, he also brings five sin-offerings. However, [in the case of] five acts of intercourse with one forbidden relation in a single lapse of awareness, she also brings only one [sin-offering], and so does he.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:17:1.hebrew: הוא בהעלם אחת - בין [בא] ה' ביאות בה' עריות, בין ה' ביאות על כל אחת:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:17:1.english: He [does so] during one lapse of awareness - Whether [he engaged in] five acts of intercourse with five forbidden women, or five acts of intercourse with each one.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:17:2.hebrew:
והן ה' העלמות - שנודע לכל אחת בין כל ביאה וביאה מביאותיו, הוא אינו חייב אלא אחת על כל אחת, והיא על כל אחת ואחת חייבת ה', דהיינו על כל ביאה וביאה. אלמא, אף על גב דהוא גרם לכל אחת להביא ה' חטאות, לא בעי הוא למייתי על כל חדא אלא אחת:
ואית ספרים דכתיב בהו: הוא בהעלם אחת והיא בה' העלמות - ובערוה אחת מיירי, לשון נקייה הוא, ויש"ר כח"ו:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:17:2.english:
And they [had] five lapses of awareness - For it became known to each one [of them] between each and every act of intercourse of his acts of intercourse; he is liable [to bring] only one [sin offering] for each one [of them], while she is liable [to bring] five — for each and every one, that is, for each and every act of intercourse. Thus [we see that] even though he caused each one to bring five sin offerings, he does not need to bring [anything] for each one except one.
And there are texts in which it is written: He in one lapse of awareness and she in five lapses of awareness - And it is speaking of one forbidden woman; it is a refined expression, and well-stated.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:19:1.hebrew: קצר - כגרוגרת בשבת — וזה השיעור — חזר וקצר בהעלם א', מה לי אמר רבי אליעזר:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:19:1.english: Reaped - [He reaped] a dried-fig's bulk on Shabbat — which is the [minimum] measure — [and] went back and reaped [again] in a single lapse of awareness; what would Rabbi Eliezer say?

Rashi on Keritot 15a:1:1.english: He slaughtered it and its daughter's daughter - he did not commit a prohibition.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:1:2.hebrew: ואחר כך שחט את בתה - של ראשונה. עכשיו נמצא ששחט ב' איסורים: ראשונה "אותו" ואת "בנו" שלישית, ושניה "בנו" ו"אותו" — ד"בנו" שניה ו"אותו" שלישית. והילכך סופג פ' לסומכוס, אף על גב דשם אחד הן:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:1:2.english: And afterward he slaughtered her daughter - [the daughter] of the first [animal]. Now it turns out that he slaughtered [in violation of] two prohibitions: the first [animal is] "it" and the third [is] "its offspring," and the second [is] "its offspring" and [the third is] "it" — for "its offspring" is the second [animal] and "it" is the third [animal]. Therefore, he incurs eighty [lashes] according to Sumakhos, even though they are [under] a single category [of prohibition].

Rashi on Keritot 15a:21:1.hebrew: שתי ביאות א"א לערב - הילכך חשיבי, [אבל] קצירת שתי גרוגרות אפשר לערב ולקצור בבת אחת:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:21:1.english: Two [acts of] intercourse are impossible to combine - Therefore they are [each] considered significant, but the reaping of two fig-bulks is possible to combine and reap at the same time.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:23:1.hebrew: ר' אליעזר מחייב על ולדי מלאכות במקום אבות מלאכות - שאם עשה אב ותולדה בהעלם אחת, חייב שתים; הא אב ואב — כגון קצר וקצר, דזו וזו אב מלאכה — פטור מן אחת:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:23:1.english: Rabbi Eliezer deems [one] liable for subcategories of [prohibited] labor in a situation [where he also performed] primary categories of [prohibited] labor - For if he performed a primary category [of labor] and a subcategory [of labor] in one lapse of awareness, he is liable [to bring] two [sin offerings]; however, [if he performed] a primary category and a primary category — such as [when] he reaped and reaped, where both this and that are a primary category of labor — he is exempt from one [of them].

Rashi on Keritot 15a:25:1.hebrew: הכא במאי עסקינן - הא דקתני רבי אליעזר כו', דדייקינן מינה: הא אב ואב, פטור:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:25:1.english: What are we dealing with here - [With] that which Rabbi Eliezer teaches, etc., from which we infer: [if one performed] a primary category [of prohibited labor] and [another] primary category, he is exempt.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:26:1.english: Of a climbing grapevine - [It] is a treille [Old French: trellis] of a grapevine.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:26:2.hebrew: המודלית על גבי תאנה - ותאנים בתאנה, ואין ענבים בגפן, והיה צריך לבצור הגפן להסקה, וקצץ בבת אחת פרי התאנה וזמורת הגפן, דחייב שתים: חדא אפרי דתאנה, דהיינו קוצר; וחדא אזמורה, דתולדה דקוצר, דקיימא לן (שבת דף עג:) זומר וצריך לעצים תולדה דקוצר היא. משום הכי חייב שתים, אף על גב דבבת אחת, הואיל ושמות מוחלקין — זה אב וזו תולדה — וגופין מוחלקין, דשני אילנות הן:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:26:2.english: That is trellised over a fig tree - [There are] figs on the fig tree, and there are no grapes on the vine, and he needed to cut the vine for fuel, and he cut at the same time the fruit of the fig tree and the branch of the vine, for which he is liable [to bring] two [sin offerings]: one for the fruit of the fig tree, which is [the primary labor of] reaping; and one for the branch, which is a subcategory of reaping, as we hold (Shabbat 73b) [that] one who prunes and needs the wood — it is a subcategory of reaping. Therefore he is liable [for] two, even though [it was done] at the same time, since [the] names [of the prohibitions] are differentiated — this is a primary labor and that is a subcategory — and [the] bodies are differentiated, as they are two [separate] trees.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:27:1.hebrew: דכוותה גבי קצר וקצר - דדייקינן הא אב ואב פטור, כגון שקצר שתי גרוגרות בבת אחת, דהשתא לאו תרתין הוא דעבד, ובבת אחת עשאן, גופין ושמות מוחלקין נמי ליכא. אבל קצר וחזר וקצר, דתרתין מלאכות עבד בהעלם אחת, מחייב ר' אליעזר:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:27:1.english: In the corresponding [case], regarding [one who] reaped and reaped - where we inferred that [for] a primary labor and a primary labor he is exempt: [this is] such as where he reaped two fig-bulks simultaneously, for now it is not two [acts] that he performed, and he performed them simultaneously; [moreover,] separate bodies and separate designations are not present either. But [if] he reaped and then reaped again, since he performed two labors in a single lapse of awareness, Rabbi Eliezer holds [him] liable.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:28:1.english: A dangling limb of an animal - Most of it is detached, and [it is] attached slightly.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:28:2.hebrew: מהו - שיטמא משום אבר מן החי כאילו נתלש לגמרי, דקיימא לן בהעור והרוטב (חולין קכח:) דאבר מן החי מטמא כנבלה:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:28:2.english: What is [its status] - [Does it mean] that it imparts ritual impurity as a limb from a living [animal], as if it were completely detached? For it is established for us in [the chapter] HaOr VeHaRotev (Chullin 128b) that a limb from a living [animal] imparts ritual impurity like a carcass.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:28:3.hebrew: אבר - הנתלש מן האדם לגמרי מטמא כמת בפרק העור והרוטב (חולין קכט:), והמדולדלת שדבוק קצת — טהור:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:28:3.english: A limb - [One] that is completely torn off from a person imparts ritual impurity like a corpse, [as taught] in the chapter [entitled] HaOr VeHaRotev (Chullin 129b); whereas a dangling [one], which is slightly attached, is ritually pure.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:4:1.hebrew: דגופין מוחלקין - שמחמת ראשונה ושניה באו אלו שני איסורים על השלישית, אבל הכא אין גופין מוחלקין:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:4:1.english: As [there are] differentiated bodies - For on account of the first and second [animals], these two prohibitions came upon the third [animal]; but here, there are no differentiated bodies.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:5:1.hebrew: דלמא כדר' אבהו - אבל הכא, אע"ג דעל ידי בתה ובת בתה ובת בנה נאסרה הזקנה עליו ג' איסורים, ואין גופין מוחלקין בה:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:5:1.english: Perhaps [it is] like [that of] Rabbi Abbahu - But here, even though through her daughter, her daughter's daughter, and her son's daughter the elderly woman became forbidden to him [with] three prohibitions, and there are no separate bodies in her [case].

Rashi on Keritot 15a:5:2.hebrew: זמה אחת - דאינו חייב על אשה ובתה ובת בתה ובת בנה בביאה אחת כמתני', אלא אחת. והיינו חמותו ואם חמותו ואם חמיו:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:5:2.english: One lewdness - That he is not liable for [intercourse with] a woman, her daughter, her daughter's daughter, and her son's daughter in a single act of intercourse, as [stated] in our Mishnah, except [for] one [sin offering]. And these are his mother-in-law, his mother-in-law's mother, and his father-in-law's mother.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:6:2.english: Emmaus - The name of the city.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:6:3.hebrew: הבא על אחותו כו' - מפרש בגמ':
Rashi on Keritot 15a:6:3.english: One who engages in intercourse with his sister, etc. - [This] is explained in the Gemara.

Rashi on Keritot 15a:8:1.hebrew: הרי שמות מוחלקין - שג' לאוין מוחלקין בהו:
Rashi on Keritot 15a:8:1.english: Behold, [there are] differentiated names - For three prohibitions are distinct in them.

Tosafot on Keritot 15a:13:1.hebrew: ערות אחותו גלה - הקשה רבינו ברוך: אמאי לא מייתי כרת דכתיב באחותו, דמצרכי רבנן להכי, ומייתי לדרבי יצחק? ויש לומר דמייתי הא דפשוט יותר. וכהאי גוונא אשכחנא בסנהדרין (דף לד:) ובמגילה (דף כ.):
Tosafot on Keritot 15a:13:1.english: "He has uncovered his sister's nakedness" - Rabbeinu Baruch raised a difficulty: Why does [the Gemara] not cite [the penalty of] karet that is written regarding one's sister, which the Rabbis require for this [derivation], and [instead] it cites [the verse used] according to Rabbi Yitzchak? And one can say that it cites this [verse] because it is more straightforward. And we find a similar [phenomenon] in Sanhedrin (34b) and in Megillah (20a).

Tosafot on Keritot 15a:8:1.hebrew: הרי שמות מוחלקים - ואף על גב דלעיל גבי עריות צריך קרא "אשה" לחייב על כל אשה ואשה, אף על גב דגופין מוחלקין, מ"מ הוה פשיטא ליה לרבי עקיבא דגופין מוחלקין חייב על כל אחת ואחת:
Tosafot on Keritot 15a:8:1.english: Aren't they differentiated names - Even though above, regarding forbidden relations, the verse [stating] "a woman" is needed to obligate [one] for each and every woman, even though [they are] differentiated bodies, nevertheless, it was obvious to Rabbi Akiva that [where there are] differentiated bodies, one is obligated for each and every one.
